title: Introducing Kaleidoscope BirdNET
reported: An integrated acoustic identification and review workflow.
wildlitics_action: A useful future audio-review pattern: retain recording, alternatives and reviewer decisions. Check component licences and local species performance before an optional audio module.

title: WILDLABS AWARDS 2026: AudioMoth Edge
reported: A project developing hardware and software for on-device sound recognition.
wildlitics_action: Track constrained-device requirements, but do not treat planned hardware as a completed camera-trap identification upgrade.

title: Introducing DroneMegaDetector
evidence_type: Preprint and author announcement; under review as stated in post
reported: A drone-image detector with tiled inference, code and weights; a preprint is linked.
wildlitics_action: Consider only for future aerial imagery. Benchmark camera-trap and aerial domains separately; do not substitute it for the terrestrial baseline.

title: TwigaTools: an open intelligence hub
reported: No-code summaries and connectors layered over existing monitoring platforms, with connectivity and permissions considered.
wildlitics_action: Use modular imports/exports and reproducible summaries; retain platform permissions and offline caches if connectors are added.

title: Speeding-up AI training
reported: Timelapse, MegaDetector and SAM2 help prepare YOLO training data. A comment dated 12 October points to Annotator-Pro.
wildlitics_action: Extend assisted annotation after checking licences, preserve per-object labels and keep manual review and site grouping. The single-class-per-image assumption needs explicit rejection for mixed scenes.

title: Automating wildlife monitoring with .NET, FFmpeg and MegaDetector
reported: A live-camera intake and frame-sampling workflow with author-reported runtime improvements.
wildlitics_action: Use timestamped local video intake, recoverable jobs and sampling-recall evaluation. No local speed claim can be transferred from this post.

title: Wildlens
evidence_type: Personal-project report without independently assessed benchmark
reported: The author reports a livestream species detector trained with iNaturalist imagery.
wildlitics_action: Use as an example of an intake/demo flow; verify training-image domain, split design, class coverage and code availability before considering the model.

title: Machine Learning for Camera Trap Footage
reported: Contributors distinguish blank filtering, species identification and individual re-identification, and emphasise review ergonomics.
wildlitics_action: Measure reviewer time and correction burden, and make individual-ID a separately validated task.

title: SpeciesNet Studio: self-hosted review UI
reported: A contributor presents a self-hosted SpeciesNet review interface.
wildlitics_action: Inspect review organisation and alternative-candidate presentation as product references; check code licence before reuse.

title: SpeciesNet Bugs on Addax AI Windows
reported: The thread discusses NumPy/PyTorch compatibility and a Windows process issue; the exact root cause was not established.
wildlitics_action: Add Windows installation/inference/cancellation checks and pinned environment diagnostics. Do not prescribe a blanket NumPy downgrade from this anecdote.
